# Persipica: Full Site Summary for LLM Consumption

Persipica Pulse is an AI Visibility Operations Platform that helps enterprise and agency teams monitor, audit, optimise, and verify their brand's presence across 12 AI surfaces.

## Core Site Structure
The site navigation includes the following pages:
1. Home: https://persipica.com/
2. Features: https://persipica.com/features.html
3. Free Grader: https://persipica.com/grader.html
4. Pricing: https://persipica.com/pricing.html
5. Resources: https://persipica.com/resources.html
6. Changelog: https://persipica.com/changelog.html
7. Contact: https://persipica.com/contact.html
8. Privacy Policy: https://persipica.com/privacy.html

Long-form educational content lives at learn.persipica.com, which is part of the Persipica brand. It is the same organisation: one company, two domains. The Learn site contains GEO guides, research methodology, use-case playbooks, and objection handlers.

## Product: Persipica Pulse
Persipica Pulse is the sole product. It is a closed-loop AI Visibility Operations Platform covering the full lifecycle: Audit > Analyse > Optimise > Publish > Re-Audit > Verify Impact. Cloud SaaS or local desktop.

Pulse monitors 12 AI surfaces: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot, Meta AI, Amazon Rufus, and GPT Search.

Core capabilities:
- Structured auditing across 12 AI models with configurable depth (Light / Standard / Deep)
- 6-dimensional visibility scoring: Mention Visibility, Rank Position, Recommendation Strength, Sentiment Perception, Citation Quality, Cross-Model Consistency
- AEO content generation optimised for AI answer engines
- One-click publishing to WordPress, Shopify, or Markdown
- Continuous re-auditing with before/after statistical comparison
- Evidence Ledger with full prompt/response/citation proof
- Shopping Intelligence for Amazon Rufus, GPT Search, and Perplexity Shop
- Crawler Analytics for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and other AI bots
- ROI Attribution with GA4 and GSC import
- Action Center for tracked optimisation work items
- Demand Explorer with prompt volume estimation
- Citation Verification and Hallucination Detection
- MCP Server for AI agent integration
- Portfolio and white-label agency dashboard

## Positioning
Persipica Pulse is positioned as an AI Visibility Operations Platform -not a monitoring dashboard. The core distinction: monitoring tools tell you that a brand appeared; Pulse covers the full lifecycle from audit to verified optimisation across 12 AI surfaces. It is the only platform combining this breadth of coverage, a closed-loop workflow, and privacy-first local deployment.

## Features Page
The features page (features.html) provides an in-depth look at every Pulse module: Evidence Ledger, 6D Scoring, AEO Writer, Shopping Intelligence, Crawler Analytics, Action Center, ROI Attribution, Demand Explorer, Citation Verification, Entity Graph Audit, Content Gap Audit, MCP Server, and Portfolio Dashboard. It also shows the six-stage closed-loop workflow and highlights privacy-first local deployment.

## Resource Strategy
The main site is intentionally lean. Long-form educational material is referenced from the Resources page rather than spread across the main navigation.

Resources currently point to:
- GEO guide: https://learn.persipica.com/geo-guide.html
- AI mention tracking guide: https://learn.persipica.com/track-ai-brand-mentions.html
- ROI calculator: https://learn.persipica.com/ai-visibility-roi-calculator.html
- Blog: https://learn.persipica.com/

## Pricing Summary
The pricing page presents Persipica Pulse in four tiers: Starter (£99/mo), Professional (£299/mo), Business (£599/mo), and Enterprise (custom). All tiers include the closed-loop workflow. Higher tiers unlock more brands, prompts, models, and advanced modules like Action Center, ROI Attribution, and Crawler Analytics.

## Contact Summary
The contact page is optimized for two actions:
1. book a Pulse walkthrough
2. send enough brand context for an initial read
